certificate_wording: Mastemy Certificate of Completion — IAS 2 Inventories

learning_outcomes.text: Define inventories and identify the costs included in their cost
Apply the measurement rule of the lower of cost and net realisable value
Apply permitted cost formulas such as FIFO and weighted average
Account for the write-down of inventory and its reversal
Explain the treatment of inventories for a manufacturer, including overhead allocation
Prepare the disclosures required for inventories

integrative_case: A manufacturer buys raw materials with import duties, incurs normal and abnormal production waste, holds a slow-moving finished-goods line whose selling price has fallen, and later sees that market recover; determine inventory cost, measure the lines at the lower of cost and net realisable value, apply a cost formula, account for the write-down and its reversal, and draft the disclosures.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
